description.p: Qwertycoin GUI is a desktop wallet for Qwertycoin v2, derived from the Monero GUI and wired to the Qwertycoin v2 core.

Privacy: Qwertycoin v2 uses a CryptoNote-derived system to allow you to send and receive funds without your transactions being easily revealed on the blockchain (the ledger of transactions that everyone has). This ensures that your purchases, receipts, and all transfers remain absolutely private by default.

Security: Using the power of a distributed peer-to-peer consensus network, every transaction on the network is cryptographically secured. Individual wallets have a 25 word mnemonic seed that is only displayed once, and can be written down to backup the wallet. Wallet files are encrypted with a passphrase to ensure they are useless if stolen.

The Qwertycoin desktop wallet keeps its inherited BSD-3-Clause license and upstream attribution while providing Qwertycoin v2 networking, local RandomX node operation and an EPoSe observer and producer interface.
